CREATE TABLE machines (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    processing_time_s DOUBLE PRECISION,
    availability DOUBLE PRECISION,
    mttr_s DOUBLE PRECISION,
    work_power_kw DOUBLE PRECISION,
    idle_power_kw DOUBLE PRECISION
);

INSERT INTO machines (id, processing_time_s, availability, mttr_s, work_power_kw, idle_power_kw)
VALUES ('M1', 200, 0.97, 900, 5.0, 0.5),
('M2', 220, 0.97, 1000, 5.5, 0.55),
('M3', 240, 0.96, 1200, 6.0, 0.6),
('M4', 260, 0.96, 1400, 7.0, 0.7),
('M5', 230, 0.97, 1100, 6.5, 0.65),
('M6', 210, 0.97, 1000, 6.0, 0.6);

CREATE TABLE buffers (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    capacity INTEGER
);

INSERT INTO buffers (id, capacity)
VALUES ('B0', 10),
('B1', 10),
('B2', 10),
('B3', 10),
('B4', 10),
('B5', 10);

CREATE TABLE tag_map (
    tag_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    machine_id TEXT,
    signal TEXT,
    unit TEXT,
    register TEXT,
    scale DOUBLE PRECISION
);

INSERT INTO tag_map (tag_id, machine_id, signal, unit, register, scale)
VALUES ('processing_time_s', 'M1', 'processing_time_s', 's', 'processing_time_s', 1.0),
('availability', 'M1', 'availability', 'unitless', 'availability', 1.0),
('mttr_s', 'M1', 'mttr_s', 's', 'mttr_s', 1.0),
('work_power_kw', 'M1', 'work_power_kw', 'kW', 'work_power_kw', 1.0),
('idle_power_kw', 'M1', 'idle_power_kw', 'kW', 'idle_power_kw', 1.0),
('buffer_capacity', 'B0', 'buffer_capacity', 'unitless', 'buffer_capacity', 1.0);

CREATE TABLE raw_ingest (
    ingested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    source TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload JSONB NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE ingest_watermark (
    source TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    max_event_ts TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE TABLE events (
    ts TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    machine_id TEXT,
    reason_code TEXT,
    duration_s DOUBLE PRECISION,
    energy_kwh DOUBLE PRECISION
);

CREATE TABLE samples (
    ts TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    machine_id TEXT,
    tag TEXT,
    value DOUBLE PRECISION
);

CREATE INDEX idx_events_machine_ts ON events (machine_id, ts);
CREATE INDEX idx_samples_machine_ts ON samples (machine_id, ts);
